The Negative of the Negative

SPXI instrument · method 0.16 of 87, level 0 (Measurement): The Negative of the Negative (/non). An instrument of SPXI, the Semantic Packet for eXchange & Indexing; the whole practice is itemized at spxi.dev/methods.

Public knowledge of an entity, constructed before the addresses at which it is found, and composed three ways: as the composition layer gave it, as its own disclosed sources give it, and with the Crimson Hexagonal Archive admitted on equal terms. Each row is adjudicated later against what the world does.

Working, not frozen. Composed under EA-NEGONT-02 v0.9 (#1690), which is being tested, iterated and revised. Status, method and procedure.

Rows are composed in session or on commission by SPXI-gnΩsis (gnosis.spxi.dev), which opens a Wikipedia revision sentence by sentence against the sources it cites; a commission consults the archive by its own procedure and composes the entity's row here. A quote is free.

26 entries, 24 with an AXN (family NON). As data: index.json (one row per entry) · claims.json (every field claim quoted, by row) · each entry's /non/{entity}/entity.json · the dataset on the Hub. Also: by type, case and month · the register (every address and transcript) · the panel (the working list).

A reader of this page finds each entry's page, its citation, at /non/{entity}/, and the entry itself (its knowledge object, every sentence with the claims it cites, each claim's quote, source and locus) at /non/{entity}/entity.json; /non/index.json lists every entry with both addresses and its AXN.
